title: Hannah Featherstone shares a new single, "Love Unconditional"
htmlContent:
Hannah Featherstone has already provided us with a broad set of songs. She’s now stated, “Love Unconditional.” Hannah Featherstone has had a lot of different influences on her music, making her sound so unique. A true testament to a great artist is the connection they can make with the listeners.

The longevity of this fast-rising star's appeal will be defined by time. Hannah Featherstone's new song “Love Unconditional” is a departure from her earlier work and has the potential to be a success. She wants fans to be able to associate with her as well as respect her miscellaneous styles and ranges.

Hannah Featherstone's “Love Unconditional” is now available for streaming on all music-related platforms.
